fieldValues.title: extension records have been invisible to check-spec-coherence.mjs's checks 2/3/5 since it shipped
fieldValues.summary: scripts/check-spec-coherence.mjs's LEAF_TYPES constant lists section, subsection, mechanism, invariant, example, design-note, table, generated-type-reference -- com.semanticops.spec/extension is absent. Every extension record has therefore been unreachable by check 2 (one-home), check 3 (no-orphan-leaf) and check 5 (no-baked-heading) since those checks landed (srs#560), independent of anything RFC-042 Revision 4 (srs#782/#783) otherwise changes. Found only because drafting that revision required reading the checker's source to scope a depends-on exception for extension.
evidence: scripts/check-spec-coherence.mjs LEAF_TYPES = new Set(["section", "subsection", "mechanism", "invariant", "example", "design-note", "table", "generated-type-reference"]) -- no "extension" entry

node scripts/check-spec-coherence.mjs on origin/master (2026-09-12) reports one-home: 542 records with a contains parent -- this count cannot include extension records if LEAF_TYPES excludes the type, since the check only walks records of a LEAF_TYPES type or CONCEPT
RFC-042 Revision 4 (rfcs/rfc-042-concept-tree-spine.md, srs#782/#783) [R19] adds "extension" to LEAF_TYPES to close this gap
